canonical_cohort_row_and_legal_vehicle_o.note: The immutable eighteen-row denominator preserves the exact public legal-vehicle label. Later manager, public-fund-name, search, and disclosure surfaces do not replace or silently alter the frozen legal entity.

publicly_identified_portfolio_investment.note: No exact fund-attributed public portfolio investment record was admitted by the complete fixed protocol. Manager-wide portfolio language, search snippets, and capital commitments are not substituted for a frozen-vehicle investment event.

publicly_identified_follow_on_investment.note: No exact fund-attributed follow-on investment record was admitted. A portfolio claim is not a follow-on event, and missing public follow-on records are not encoded as zero follow-on activity.

publicly_identified_exits.note: No exact fund-attributed exit, sale, IPO, acquisition disposition, or other realized disposal record was admitted. An investment or manager portfolio statement is not an exit.

publicly_identified_write_offs_or_realiz.note: No exact fund-attributed write-off or realized-loss record was admitted. Missing public loss disclosure is not proof that no loss occurred.

publicly_identified_defaults_or_cures.note: No exact fund-attributed default or cure record was admitted. License, leverage eligibility, commitment, and outstanding exposure are not default or cure events.

publicly_identified_realized_fund_return.note: No exact frozen-fund realized-return or distribution record was admitted. Manager performance, portfolio exits, and private capital commitments are not realized fund returns.

canonical_cohort_row_and_legal_vehicle_o.note: The immutable eighteen-row denominator preserves the exact public legal-vehicle label. Later manager, public-fund-name, search, and disclosure surfaces do not replace or silently alter the frozen legal entity.

publicly_identified_portfolio_investment.note: No exact fund-attributed public portfolio investment record was admitted by the complete fixed protocol. Manager-wide portfolio language, search snippets, and capital commitments are not substituted for a frozen-vehicle investment event.

publicly_identified_follow_on_investment.note: No exact fund-attributed follow-on investment record was admitted. A portfolio claim is not a follow-on event, and missing public follow-on records are not encoded as zero follow-on activity.

publicly_identified_exits.note: No exact fund-attributed exit, sale, IPO, acquisition disposition, or other realized disposal record was admitted. An investment or manager portfolio statement is not an exit.

publicly_identified_write_offs_or_realiz.note: No exact fund-attributed write-off or realized-loss record was admitted. Missing public loss disclosure is not proof that no loss occurred.

publicly_identified_defaults_or_cures.note: No exact fund-attributed default or cure record was admitted. License, leverage eligibility, commitment, and outstanding exposure are not default or cure events.

publicly_identified_realized_fund_return.note: No exact frozen-fund realized-return or distribution record was admitted. Manager performance, portfolio exits, and private capital commitments are not realized fund returns.
